title: Pocketwire Rewards Long-Service Anniversary Supplement
content:
Pocketwire Rewards members with at least 3 whole years of membership receive the anniversary tenure supplement on their anniversary bonus.

## Rule

The anniversary tenure supplement is 2000 points when the membership has completed at least 5 whole years, 1000 points when it has completed at least 3 but fewer than 5 whole years, and nothing when it has completed fewer than 3 whole years. The supplement is added to the anniversary bonus credited for the anniversary, in whole points.

The membership's whole years are the whole months from the enrolment date to the handling date divided by twelve and rounded down, a whole month being reached on the same calendar day of a later month.

## Supplement by whole years

| Whole years of membership on the handling date | Anniversary tenure supplement |
|---|---|
| 5 or more | 2000 points |
| 3 or 4 | 1000 points |
| 0, 1 or 2 | nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical membership enrolled on 15 June 2020)

| Handling date | Whole months | Whole years | Supplement |
|---|---|---|---|
| 14 June 2023 | 35 | 2 | nothing |
| 15 June 2023 | 36 | 3 | 1000 points |
| 14 June 2025 | 59 | 4 | 1000 points |
| 15 June 2025 | 60 | 5 | 2000 points |
